ER Abridged: What To Do When Misconduct Happens

A practical guide for responding to possible misconduct with facts, fairness and the right level of support.

Landing Page

Course Overview

Purpose

Build manager confidence when workplace conduct concerns arise.

Approach

Use a practical decision process instead of memorising every policy clause.

Practice

Work through scenarios, knowledge checks, accordions, matching activities and reflections.

Outcome

Know when to gather facts, apply fairness, choose a response and involve the Fuse.
